audit_scope: Pinned PySCF v2.8.0 source; no engine imported or science run on Mac
fixed_state: Frozen periodic01/input.json unchanged: FCCNe a4.46Angstrom, Ne10electrons14AO; Gamma RKS/PBE cc-pVDZ GDF/weigend Becke level1, precision1e-6, SCF conv_tol1e-8 max80 unchanged

API.lattice_vectors: cell.lattice_vectors() returns ndarray Bohr. In v2.8 no unit keyword accepted; user-suggested unit=Bohr would fail. Verified exact implementation.
API.atom_coords: Inherited Mole.atom_coords(unit=Bohr); runtime regression checks convert against ASE coordinates.
API.serialization: np.asarray(value).tolist() for list/ndarray; strict JSON allow_nan false; Å input never labeled Bohr.

GDF_path: Default GDF._make_j3c selects _RSGDFBuilder when _prefer_ccdf false and omega0. Default builder.mesh is None, _guess_omega derives reciprocal mesh from auxiliary basis and precision, not giant Cell default. Nuclear attraction uses _RSNucBuilder with omega .5 at one kpoint. Two-center metric tightens precision to aux.precision**1.5; screen evaluates1e-12 conservatively without changing actual integration parameters.
FFT_risk: Range separation still has reciprocal/smooth-density FFT components, not FFT-free. Default uniform Cell mesh does not prove allocation. Predicted primary, nuclear and conservative metric grids are screened before GDF build. Remaining smooth-basis/extended-cell, block and file overheads cannot be bounded exactly by this estimate.
memory: AO14 means packed105pairs, dense196entries only. Actual auxiliary count and3c payload saved at runtime. Estimated reciprocal workspace includes two complex buffers over (pairs+aux+16)*max-gridpoints, rejected above256MiB. It is an admission screening estimate, not a validated total memory upper bound. GDF internal max_memory floors1000/2000MB do not enforce memory; cgroup1GiB authoritative. Runtime may still fail/OOM and must stop.
temp_storage: tmpfs512MiB counts within same1GiB cgroup. Actual free bytes recorded; 16-copy packed3c allowance must fit half remaining temp. Additional overhead UNKNOWN, no hidden disk/spill or swap.
Becke: BeckeGrids level1 uses atomic-centered grids and periodic image filtering, not Cell.mesh uniform allocation. Explicit grid build and actual point count saved before SCF; not grid convergence certified.
stages: WORLD_SPEC_VALIDATED, ASE_PERIODIC_ATOMS_CONSTRUCTED, PYSCF_CELL_BUILT, CONSTRUCTION_EVIDENCE_SAVED, GDF_INITIALIZATION_STARTED/FINISHED, PERIODIC_SCF_STARTED/FINISHED, OBSERVATION_SAVED plus per-cycle records. Completed stage files persist if later stage fails.
current_resource_admission: RUNTIME_PENDING. Static path supports a bounded attempt, not assurance of completion. No fixed numerical mesh changed or approximation relaxed.
local_tests: Actual lightweight NumPy list/ndarray serialization; mocked Cell unit conversion and deliberate wrong-unit rejection; stage persistence; inherited geometry/domain tests. Not real ASE/PySCF integration proof.
external_scope: One new manual standard Ubuntu Job max15min;1CPU/1thread/1GiB/0extraSwap/no science network; no DATA/AS caps, no rerun, no P3/HF. Not authorized by this file.
failure_preservation: Existing independent parent process writes failure/observation/process receipts; stdout/stderr and atomic stage files saved to /out. Workflow always exports bounded ordinary logs, no artifacts/cache/Packages. Native child death does not automatically kill parent; whole-cgroup/Job death may truncate finalization and is not guaranteed recoverable.
public_review: Only generic repair code, synthetic unit tests, public model/API audit and capability status. No private XREM data, credentials or workstation paths in proposed public source. Future runtime results must be reviewed individually before publication.
